message.content:
An illustration of a magazine cover is set against a solid red background. Centered is the large word "TEMPO" in black serif lettering. Three men in brown military-style uniforms, including shirts with breast pockets and matching trousers tucked into black boots, stand in a circle around a chalk-like outline of a body on the ground. The man on the right has visible facial features, while the faces of the other two on the left and in the center are shadowed or dark. All three men have their arms extended, pointing their index fingers at one another.

Large white text at the bottom reads "SIAPA PEMBUNUH BRIGADIR YOSUA". Smaller white text below states: "Brigadir Yosua disebut tewas di rumah Kepala Divisi Profesi dan Pengamanan Polri Inspektur Jenderal Ferdy Sambo. Benarkah ada persekongkolan menghilangkan jejak pembunuhnya? H.68". At the top, smaller text includes "Ruang Publik Citayam Fashion Week H.58" and "Transisi Energi Setengah Hati H.82", alongside a barcode and QR code. Additional publication details are located under the barcode.
